newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index down in Feb 16 wk.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index down in Feb 16 wk.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News index of consumer comfort fell four points to -3.0 in the week ended February 16 from 1.0 the prior week.

The survey, this time with 1,025 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
Respondents' confidence in the economy fell to 0.0 from 2.0 the previous week.
Confidence in personal finances fell to 18 from 24, while Americans' rating of buying climate decreased four points to -26.
Confidence fell in all major regions of the nation. It was down six points to -4.0 in the South, while in the Midwest it fell four points to -2.0.
Confidence fell three points to -3.0 in the West and two points to 0.0 in the Northeast.
